    if (!window.OnetrustActiveGroups || typeof window.OnetrustActiveGroups !== 'string') {
      return false;
    }

    return window.OnetrustActiveGroups.indexOf('C0004') !== -1;

  function expireCookie(cookieName, domain) {
    var cookieString = cookieName + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/; SameSite=Lax';
    if (domain) {
      cookieString += '; domain=' + domain;
    }

    document.cookie = cookieString;
  }

  function clearPubcidCookie() {
    var cookieName = '_pubcid';
    var hostname = window.location && window.location.hostname ? window.location.hostname : '';
    var attemptedDomains = {};
    var domain = hostname;

    // Try host-only and parent domains, with and without leading dot.
    expireCookie(cookieName);
    while (domain && domain.indexOf('.') !== -1) {
      if (!attemptedDomains[domain]) {
        expireCookie(cookieName, domain);
        attemptedDomains[domain] = true;
      }

      var dottedDomain = '.' + domain;
      if (!attemptedDomains[dottedDomain]) {
        expireCookie(cookieName, dottedDomain);
        attemptedDomains[dottedDomain] = true;
      }

      domain = domain.substring(domain.indexOf('.') + 1);
    }
  }

  function clearPubcidStorage() {
    var storageTargets = [window.localStorage, window.sessionStorage];

    storageTargets.forEach(function (storage) {
      if (!storage) {
        return;

      try {
        for (var i = storage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
